name: send_attachments
title: 发送文件到群聊
description: Send workspace images, videos or other files as your group message, previewable in the chat. Use it whenever members should see media you produced.

name: service_start
title: 启动托管服务
description: Start a long-running service managed by gonggong (e.g. a dev server) that outlives the turn; then preview_expose it. Restarting a name keeps its preview cards working, no need to publish again.

name.description: Service name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, up to 32), unique per group and bot

command.description: Shell command run in the workspace

port.description: Port it listens on; waits until ready (up to 60 s)

display.description: Desktop apps: virtual runs on a new virtual display (Xvfb), not the owner's screen, and preview_gui streams all of it; Linux only

name: service_list
title: 托管服务列表
description: Your managed services here: name, state, port, uptime.

name: service_logs
title: 托管服务日志
description: Tail of a managed service's output (stdout and stderr).

name.description: Service name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, up to 32), unique per group and bot

name: service_stop
title: 停止托管服务
description: Stop a managed service and its children. Its preview cards stay and show it stopped until it is started again.

name.description: Service name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, up to 32), unique per group and bot

name: preview_static
title: 发布静态页面
description: Publish workspace static files (HTML reports, builds…) as a site with a preview card; no server needed.

dir.description: Workspace dir to publish (e.g. dist, docs/report), default the root

name: html_preview
title: 预览 HTML
description: Optional check before html_render: returns a PNG, contentHeight and console output. Inline <style> and <script>. Local images given as absolute paths are inlined. Remote URLs load as-is. Rules are in html_render.

width.description: CSS pixels, 240 to 1600. Default 720. Use about 390 for phones.

name: html_render
title: 在群聊中展示 HTML
description: Show a finished HTML page inline in your final reply; the result gives its id to place it there; do not restate it. Height fits the page up to 20000px. Inline <style> and <script>. Local images given as absolute paths are inlined. Remote URLs load as-is. Width is the reply column (720px desktop, ~360px phones) on the chat background. html, body and the outer element get no background, outer card, border, banner title or side padding (overrides any page-background rule). An inner box with its own background gets 16px padding and var(--radius). Charts get fixed pixel heights. Content sets the height: no vh units (rejected) or height:100% on html/body (loops). A clicked image opens in the host’s zoomable viewer; build no lightbox. Image facts (resolution, size, path) go as small tags over its bottom-left corner, not a block of their own. Use theme CSS variables, not fixed colors: --background, --foreground, --muted, --card, --popover, --secondary, --border, --ring, --primary, --accent, --destructive, --warning, --success, --info, --code-background (most have -foreground; accent, destructive, warning, success also -surface), --chart-1..6, --radius, --font-sans, --font-mono. The base sheet sets background, 14px text and font, and follows the reader’s light/dark theme.

height.description: Frame height in CSS pixels, 80 to 2000. Default: the page's own, measured; set it only to cut a long page short.

name: client_release_publish
title: 发布客户端到当前空间
description: Upload client builds from scripts/release.sh (gg, gg-cast, desktop installers and updates) to this space; members update from here. Prefer dir for a whole dist/<version> (one approval), file for one more file, dir with kind="daemon" for gg only. Sysadmin turns only.

file.description: One build output, workspace-relative (e.g. dist/0.3.1/gonggong-0.3.1-macos-aarch64), named as scripts/release.sh names it

dir.description: A whole dir, workspace-relative (e.g. dist/0.3.1): uploads every release file and RELEASE_NOTES.md, skipping SHA256SUMS, manifest.json and subdirs

kind.description: Only gg and gg-cast (no desktop app); dir needs every platform

name: client_release_notes
title: 更新客户端版本说明
description: Write the Markdown notes of the current release, shown at the next update check. Sysadmin turns only.

releaseNotes.description: Full Markdown release notes, shown in desktop and daemon update prompts

name: feishu_send_card
title: 发送飞书卡片
description: Send a custom card to the bound Feishu chat as this bot's Feishu app, replying to the message that started the turn. Read the feishu-card skill first. Ordinary replies sync to Feishu by themselves.

card.description: Feishu card JSON 2.0 (see the feishu-card skill); a local image goes in as a placeholder img_key such as "chart"

images.description: Placeholder → workspace image path, e.g. {"chart": "out/chart.png"}; up to 10, 10 MB each

name: preview_miniprogram
title: 发布小程序预览
description: Open the workspace mini program in WeChat DevTools on this machine at a page and post a card with a simulator screenshot; call again to switch pages. It handles launch, login (QR code on the card) and trust: never drive DevTools yourself or send QR codes.

dir.description: Workspace dir of the mini program (with project.config.json), default the root

page.description: Page to open, e.g. pages/goods/detail, default the home page
